links.outcome: Zero-shot LLM accuracy predicting PTSD item scores from interview transcripts versus PCL-C
links.effect: Binary accuracy best 0.705 (Claude 4); Likert accuracy best 0.438 (DeepSeek 3.1), only modestly above majority-class baseline 0.399; deemed insufficient for clinical application.
links.quote: Zero-shot LLMs' performance was insufficient for clinical application in predicting PTSD symptoms from semi-structured interview transcripts.

screen.reason: Evaluates zero-shot performance of multiple LLMs on retrospective clinical interview transcripts to predict PTSD symptom severity without testing a specific deployment practice or guardrail.
